snippet.title: ACUVAC Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist ACUVAC: A Suck and Blow Adventure on Steam! Launches August 20th! --- https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333940/ACUVAC_A_Suck_and_Blow_Adventure/

Take control of a chaotic canister vacuum in this physics sandbox collectathon adventure! 

ACUVAC is a fresh and unique upcoming indie game set to release this month, with all the passion, hard work, and care you'd expect put into an indie game. Don't miss out on this memorable title -- wishlist it today on Steam!

Join the discord community to get more involved with ACUVAC and future game development from CurdleGames! https://discord.gg/8Qq4SR75wW
